visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of five people, three females and two males, are gathered in a brightly lit indoor studio. The central male character, wearing a white t-shirt, sits in front while the others stand or sit behind and beside him. They are engaged in an animated conversation with lively facial expressions and hand gestures. (2) The central man reaches down and pulls up a green, mesh-like scarf, holding it out with both hands. The surrounding group reacts with open mouths and smiles, indicating excitement. (3) He displays a green plastic cup with a lid and straw, featuring a white logo. He turns it to show the camera while the others lean in to inspect it. (4) A small linen drawstring bag with a printed graphic is presented. The man holds it up, showing its contents to the group. (5) He holds up a pair of bright pink and grey striped socks. He stretches them out to show the pattern, and a woman on the left touches them. (6) A wooden hair comb is produced. The man begins to comb his hair while looking towards the camera, smiling, as the others laugh. (7) He reveals a blue and cyan package for a car diffuser. He holds the product box next to his face, gesturing towards it while speaking. (8) He fans out several paper vouchers for a fast-food restaurant, looking particularly enthusiastic with a wide smile and wide eyes. (9) He shows a blue lace-trimmed drawstring bag. Another character points at the bag, specifically at a white price tag still attached to the side. (10) The mood shifts as he pulls out an old, heavily stained, and used-looking striped oven mitt. Everyone recoils slightly with expressions of disgust and confusion. He holds the mitt up high, looking around at the others with a questioning gaze.
